rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the flesh around the teeth.

example.english: The gum around my molar is swollen.
example.traditional: 我隻大牙旁邊塊牙肉腫咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 daai6 ngaa4 pong4 bin1 faai3 ngaa4 juk6 zung2 zo2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for chewing gum in general.

example.english: Children shouldn't chew gum all the time.
example.traditional: 細路仔唔好成日食香口膠。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 sik6 hoeng1 hau2 gaau1

rows.note: Use this counted phrase when you mean one individual piece of chewing gum.

example.english: I dropped one piece of gum on the school bus.
example.traditional: 我喺校巴度跌咗一粒香口膠落地。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 haau6 baa1 dou6 dit3 zo2 jat1 nap1 hoeng1 hau2 gaau1 lok6 dei6
